about__description: I'm Hongdao Meng, an AI Engineer based in San Jose, California. case_deepfake__meta: An image and audio deepfake detection project by Hongdao Meng, with model inference, Vision Transformer fine-tuning, and evaluation.
case_deepfake__card: Image and audio detection, from uploaded media to model predictions.
case_deepfake__intro: Bringing image and audio classification into an approachable web interface, alongside a dedicated Vision Transformer training workflow.
case_deepfake__scope: Media processing, model integration, and a reproducible path from fine-tuning to evaluation.
case_deepfake__problem: A detection model is only one part of the experience. Users also need a simple way to submit media and understand the prediction, while developers need a separate workflow to train and evaluate the model.
case_deepfake__step1_detail: Django views accept image or audio files through dedicated forms.
case_deepfake__step2_detail: Images are resized and normalized; audio becomes a mel spectrogram.
case_deepfake__step3_detail: TensorFlow and PyTorch models handle the two media paths.
case_deepfake__step4_detail: The interface displays the predicted label and model score.
case_deepfake__contribution1: Connected media upload, preprocessing, and inference within the web application.
case_deepfake__contribution2: Added a Vision Transformer fine-tuning pipeline with class-weighted loss and checkpoint selection.
case_deepfake__contribution3: Separated model evaluation into a script reporting precision, recall, F1, and a classification report.
case_deepfake__outcome: The project connects two detection workflows in one application and includes a separate ViT experiment pipeline. The code makes both the user-facing prediction flow and the model-development process available to explore.
case_rag__document_title: Hybrid Retrieval for RAG — Hongdao Meng
case_rag__meta: Hongdao Meng’s hybrid retrieval project combines BGE-M3, Milvus, query expansion, result fusion, and reranking for relevant context retrieval.
case_rag__card: Sparse and dense search meet query expansion and reranking.
case_rag__intro: A retrieval pipeline that combines lexical and semantic signals, then refines the results before they become useful context.
case_rag__scope: The retrieval layer behind knowledge-driven applications: query processing, candidate fusion, and relevance ranking.
case_rag__problem: Keyword matching can miss related meaning; semantic search can overlook exact terms. Combining the two gives a query more ways to find relevant passages, while reranking helps select the strongest candidates.
case_rag__step1_detail: LLM-assisted query expansion adds related context to the input.
case_rag__step2_detail: BGE-M3 produces sparse and dense query representations.
case_rag__step3_detail: Milvus combines both searches with reciprocal rank fusion.
case_rag__step4_detail: A BGE reranker refines the retrieved passages before returning results.
case_rag__contribution1: Integrated BGE-M3 embeddings and Milvus hybrid search into a single retrieval path.
case_rag__contribution2: Combined query expansion, candidate fusion, and optional reranking behind a Flask API.
case_rag__contribution3: Made the search pipeline accessible from a web interface, with configurable retrieval and ranking components.
case_rag__outcome: A searchable prototype for comparing and combining lexical and semantic retrieval. Its public implementation makes the route from a user query to ranked passages explicit—the context-retrieval foundation for a RAG system.
case_voice-agent__meta: A voice-driven assistant project by Hongdao Meng, connecting LangChain tool calling, FastAPI, conversation workflows, and persistent task data.
case_voice-agent__card: A conversational prototype for reminders, records, and everyday tasks.
case_voice-agent__intro: A voice-first assistant prototype that connects natural conversation with tools for reminders, appointments, and personal records.
case_voice-agent__scope: Tool orchestration and conversational state, designed around an accessible voice and text interface.
case_voice-agent__problem: Everyday tasks often involve several screens and forms. This project explores a conversational interface for older adults, translating a spoken request into a structured action while keeping the conversation understandable.
case_voice-agent__step1_detail: Voice or text input enters through the web interface.
case_voice-agent__step2_detail: The agent uses conversation history to interpret the request.
case_voice-agent__step3_detail: LangChain selects tools for reminders, records, and appointments.
case_voice-agent__step4_detail: Task results return to the conversation and structured data is stored.
case_voice-agent__contribution1: Connected voice and text interaction with an asynchronous FastAPI and WebSocket service.
case_voice-agent__contribution2: Organized task capabilities as LangChain tools, with conversation memory and a LangGraph workflow implementation.
case_voice-agent__contribution3: Integrated persistent records and task queries so the assistant can act on stored information.
case_voice-agent__outcome: An end-to-end assistant prototype that demonstrates conversation, tool execution, and data persistence in one flow. The repository includes both the agent implementation and the structured conversation workflow.
